scope: One isolated native-weld bookkeeping diagnostic; not the required full300 benchmark or an idle/extraction acceptance test

interface.verification: Native compute_connection_transform must verify actual local interface frames before stepping

fixture.other_actors_colliders: None: no table, ground, plate, robot or additional rigid/static collider. Record inventory and connected-component collision suppression. Construction alone does not verify reporting completeness.

unchanged.native: Same installed binary, public physical thresholds, native connection construction, gravity, material and collision assets. Record hashes and all public threshold values; debug dumps are reporting only.
disallowed: further fixtures selected from observed outcomes

required_evidence.actor: Actual mass, local COM, inertia tensor and inertia-frame orientation, body pose, world linear/angular velocities, damping values, gravity vector/flags, solver properties. Mark authored versus runtime provenance and unavailable fields.
required_evidence.frames: Root is body-bottom reference, not necessarily COM. Compare moments only in a documented common world frame about actual same-step COM.
required_evidence.timing: Steps 0..N consecutive, per-step time before/after, dt, pre/post state and COM, explicit native dump-to-step mapping and callback ordering. No ambiguous filename-order association.
required_evidence.native: Preserve native debug dumps, installed binary and reader hashes, matrix/solution units and body mapping. Native J/H are external estimates after internal weld-impulse subtraction, not an independent contact sensor.
required_evidence.weld: Raw weld impulse/couple only if independently exposed. If unavailable, record unavailable. Do not infer weld impulse from delta momentum minus native J/H and present the identity as independent validation.

analysis.gravity_linear_reference: Jg = actual_mass * actual_world_gravity * actual_dt, SI N s
analysis.external_angular_reference: Zero angular gravity impulse about actual upper COM. Conditional on no other external torque; observed damping, gyroscopic/finite-step and frame/time conventions remain explicit, not guessed away.
analysis.residuals: Report vector and norm of native_J-Jg and native_H in N s and N m s on every valid aligned prebreak step. Break-step results remain separate with event-time caveat.
analysis.characteristic_length_definition: Fixed half diagonal of nominal 32x16 mm 2x4 body footprint; a dimensional reporting reference, not a calibrated moment arm
analysis.normalized_residuals: Report residual norms / S_J and / S_H where nonzero; no arbitrary percentage is a physical correctness or overload criterion.
analysis.momentum: Report delta(m*v_world); angular delta(R_world_inertia * I_principal * R_world_inertia^T * omega_world) only if inertia convention and world velocities are known. Raw changes include weld reactions and cannot be compared to gravity alone as total-load validation.
analysis.eccentric_reaction: A nonzero raw weld reaction couple is physically legitimate under eccentric support. It is not expected to be zero. The hypothesis concerns transport/subtraction about COM, not removal of legitimate support moment.

serialization_tolerances.meaning: Float32-versus-configured-double serialization comparison only; not a physical parameter, uncertainty or residual acceptance threshold. Trace clock association remains 1e-7 s.

integrity_gates: Exactly two fixture actors and one initial native link, transform/one-stud overlap verified
Installed binary/thresholds/default32/4/epsilon/dt match frozen capture protocol
Actual state, mass, COM and inertia finite and explicitly mapped to native body IDs
Consecutive step clocks, raw state/native dump association and units/frame conventions valid
No poststep reset, extra actor/collider, omitted failure event or unreported retry

interpretation.if_mismatch: A descriptive load-accounting inconsistency conditional on recorded assumptions; not proof of a lever-arm bug or physical overload until frame, damping and timing alternatives are excluded.
interpretation.if_agreement: This eccentric fixture does not expose the hypothesized inconsistency; it does not validate redundant full300 lattice stability or all native load accounting.
interpretation.if_break: One-stud capacity may legitimately be exceeded under eccentric support. Breakage alone is not proof of bookkeeping error.
interpretation.promotion: None. Full300 idle remains failed; extraction, insertion and repeated sorting remain unvalidated. Stop after one frozen diagnostic and report evidence/unknowns.
